findings.title: Severe consequence does not authorize invented austerity
findings.claim: Within the pericope, the severe-consequence pair also guards against unauthorized tightening: what God has made lawful is not to be made forbidden by private austerity, and the same boundary is not permission to cross its stated limit.
findings.mechanism: The focus tightening, punitive-consequence, and protective-forgiveness carriers contact 5:87's prohibition, release, and limit-crossing occurrences. That contact makes severity answerable to an authorized boundary in both directions, so mercy and lawful good remain inside the guarded line.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive a measured boundary between needless self-denial and permissive excess rather than treating fear of consequence as a reason to maximize restriction.
findings.containment: The ordinary severe-punishment and forgiveness predicates remain intact. The legacy-unbound context roles are retained only as attributed evidence; this does not turn one ascetic correction into a complete theory of all restrictions.

findings.title: Fātiḥa widens the field of knowing
findings.claim: The added Fātiḥa phrase gives the focus command to know a bounded wider field: the paired divine predicates are encountered against the totality of created worlds, without changing the command into a noun for worlds.
findings.mechanism: The focus knowing carrier contacts the external 1:2 occurrence عَٰلَمِينَ through the same ع ل م root. The external worlds term supplies scale for the field within which the focus facts are to be known, while the focus verb remains a command to understand.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus command can be heard within a wider created field rather than as a detached instruction about two attributes alone.
findings.containment: This is a phase-two exploratory overlay. It does not transfer the worlds branch to the focus form, claim a whole-Fātiḥa thesis, or add a cosmological purpose absent from the packet.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus QAC occurrence and external 1:2 root/word occurrence are supplied, but the scale effect is an authored inference without an attached support trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus imperative ٱعْلَمُوا۟ carries the commanded act of knowing the two divine fact clauses.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fātiḥa 1:2 names the worlds through the external عَٰلَمِينَ occurrence of the same root.
branch_activations.activation: The external worlds occurrence contacts the focus knowing carrier through the shared root, widening the field against which the focus facts are framed while preserving the verbal command.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus predicates can be known within the frame of the created totality rather than as an isolated dyad.
branch_activations.boundary: The external word supplies scale only; it does not make the focus verb mean worlds or establish a whole-surah argument.

findings.title: Fātiḥa gives consequence an accountability horizon
findings.claim: The added Fātiḥa judgment-day frame gives the focus consequence term a final accountability horizon, while leaving its local severe-response reading intact.
findings.mechanism: The focus result-and-consequence carrier contacts the external 1:4 owner, day, and judgment occurrences. The external judgment frame turns the consequence into an outcome heard against eventual accounting rather than only an immediate response.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus warning becomes perceptible as answerable conduct with a horizon beyond the immediate legal example.
findings.containment: This is a phase-two qualified overlay. It does not make every focus detail eschatological, replace the pericope's local consequence mechanisms, or specify a final judgment procedure.

epistemic.reason: The external 1:4 occurrences and the focus's qualified outcome branch are exact, but the accountability effect is an authored overlay inference without a support trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir süreç veya işin vardığı son durum ve nihai sonuç temel anlamı oluşturur.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus consequence noun carries the result reached after a process or act.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fātiḥa 1:4 names ownership of the day of judgment through its three supplied word occurrences.
branch_activations.activation: The judgment-day trigger contacts the outcome facet, giving the focus consequence a final-accounting horizon without displacing its punitive response facet.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The severe consequence can be heard as an outcome answerable before a final judgment horizon.
branch_activations.boundary: Only the outcome facet is activated here; the overlay does not rewrite the focus as an exclusively eschatological statement.

findings.title: The named evaluator is also the worshipped subject
findings.claim: The added Fātiḥa act of exclusive worship and help-seeking gives the focus's named Allah an active devotional relation, so the paired predicates are heard as belonging to the one worshipped and relied upon.
findings.mechanism: The two focus Allah occurrences contact the external worship and help-seeking occurrences in 1:5. The named subject remains the carrier while worship supplies a concrete relation that changes the focus from an isolated statement about a name into an address situated before the worshipped source.
findings.reader_payoff: The focus's command and paired predicates become relational: the boundary is spoken before the one to whom worship and reliance are directed.
findings.containment: This is a phase-two qualified overlay. It does not turn the focus into a prayer verse, add a worship command to it, or replace its concrete consequence and mercy predicates.

epistemic.reason: The external worship/help occurrences and the focus named-source coordinates are exact, while the relation is an authored overlay inference without a support trust label.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus proper-name occurrences carry the named subject of the two divine predicates.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Fātiḥa 1:5 supplies exclusive worship and seeking help directed to Allah.
branch_activations.activation: The worship and reliance acts contact the named focus subject, placing the consequence and mercy predicates within an active devotional relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The focus name can be heard as the worshipped source before whom the command to know and the paired predicates stand.
branch_activations.boundary: The focus remains a legal-moral address; the external act does not add a worship instruction to 5:98.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus proper name carries the named divine referent of the predicates.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The external worship occurrence identifies Allah as the one to whom worship is directed.
branch_activations.activation: The worshipped-entity facet contacts the focus name, giving the paired severe and merciful predicates an explicit subject relation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Allah's evaluation and mercy are heard as belonging to the named worshipped source, not to a generic deity noun.
branch_activations.boundary: The extension requires the core worship relation and does not introduce a second divine referent or new legal rule.
